project: LingRuntime (LingBot World v2 1.3B, Strix Halo / gfx1151)
sourceOfTruthNote: This file is the machine-readable DAG state. docs/lingruntime/RESEARCH_AND_EXPERIMENT_DAG.md explains it for humans. Neither file duplicates full evidence contents; both reference existing artifacts by path.

resourcesAllowed.source-cpu: reading/writing source, docs, or DAG state; no GPU involved
resourcesAllowed.api-research: DSH/LLM-backed research campaign; no local GPU involved
resourcesAllowed.gpu-light: brief, non-sustained GPU use (e.g. device/env verification) that does not require exclusive ownership of the Radeon 8060S
resourcesAllowed.gpu-exclusive: sustained and/or timing-sensitive GPU work; only one gpu-exclusive node may run at a time on the Radeon 8060S
resourcesAllowed.implementation: code/config authoring, safely parallelizable in isolated worktrees; its GPU evaluation step (if any) is gpu-exclusive and must be called out explicitly in that node's notes

updateRule: Append to changelog on every accepted result; never rewrite or delete a prior node result/status to make history look cleaner. Corrections are new changelog entries, not edits to old ones.

nodes.result: Source/runtime inspection sufficient to make Phase 0 executable; quantitative questions require the real gfx1151 runtime. Recommended: device/stack gate, then one warmed rolled RC1 waterfall, then an A/A noise floor. Explicitly deferred: exact DiT/KV/attention interventions, HIP graph capture.
nodes.notes: Produced by a DSH campaign researching this project; the conclusion above is what carried forward into this repository. Full campaign artifact stays in dsh-research-team.

nodes.name: Strix Halo environment / gfx1151 gate
nodes.question: Is execution actually and unambiguously on the Radeon 8060S / gfx1151, with a known-consistent ROCm/HIP/PyTorch/Triton/TunableOp stack?
exitCriteria: exactly one CUDA/HIP device visible, name and gcnArchName both match Radeon 8060S / gfx1151
no CPU or alternate-GPU fallback possible under HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES/CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
repo/upstream/model revisions recorded
nodes.result: PASS. Single unambiguous Radeon 8060S / gfx1151 device. PyTorch 2.13.0+rocm7.15.0a20260728, HIP 7.15.0, Triton 3.8.0+git4cff872c.rocm7.15.0a20260728, TunableOp enabled with 16 validator-matched results. Repo HEAD add8a69, upstream 45fa406, model revision 7e36a5f.
nodes.notes: Captured with the existing scripts/env_report.sh; not re-derived here.

nodes.name: Warmed RC1 Phase 0 waterfall
nodes.question: Where does a warmed, rolled RC1 12+6 action's latency actually go, and does it reproduce the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 measurement?
exitCriteria: >=3 independent unprofiled A/A rollouts captured
one representative rolled waterfall action captured with per-forward GPU-synchronized boundaries
classified against the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 measurement
nextIf: measured hotspots become candidate input to C5 only after C3/C4 confirm they remain relevant under the quality-approved configuration (see Parked Findings)
nodes.result: PASS/reproduced. Base-RGB median 939.9 ms (927.6-954.5 ms range, n=12 pooled rolled actions). Next-ready median 1258.9 ms (1244.8-1272.3 ms range). Reproduces the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 P50 (938.4 ms / 1255.3 ms) within measured A/A noise (delta +1.5 ms / +3.6 ms). Three serialized denoise forwards (~910 ms, ~97% of base-RGB) dominate base-RGB latency. The exact clean-KV forward (~298-300 ms) dominates most of the additional delay from base-RGB to next-ready (~93% of that ~320 ms delta). No optimization implemented.
nodes.notes: An independently-derived cross-check of this same raw evidence was reportedly written in the primary LingBot working tree on 2026-09-12 but is not committed on any branch as of this DAG; do not treat it as a citable artifact until it is committed and its path is confirmed. See 'Ambiguities' in the DAG markdown.

nodes.name: State/cache semantic correctness
nodes.question: Do sink/recent cache semantics, ordering/positions, eviction, wrap, reset, recurrence, and the exact clean-KV transaction all hold correctly under the accepted RC1 configuration and under stress (long rollouts, rollover, direction change, revisit)?
exitCriteria: sink/recent cache semantics verified
eviction/wrap/reset behavior verified
clean-KV transaction ordering verified under stress
explicit PASS or FAIL/inconclusive verdict recorded
nextIf: FAIL or inconclusive -> C2 stays blocked; this DAG must be updated with the failure before any further work proceeds down this branch
nodes.notes: Owned by another agent (Codex C) as of 2026-09-12; this repository's docs/research-orchestration branch does not run, does not invent, and does not assume the result of this campaign. Uses the Radeon 8060S; no other gpu-exclusive node may run concurrently with it.

nodes.name: Quality causality investigation
nodes.question: Under a matched-state comparison, what in the current pipeline actually determines output quality, and does the RC1 latency-oriented configuration (3-step denoise, TAEHV presentation, 12+6 window) hold acceptable quality, or does some axis need to change before we freeze a contract in C3?
exitCriteria: bounded chunk/context screen completed with a recorded verdict
any triggered follow-up branches (see nextIf) completed or explicitly deferred with a reason

nextIf.condition: chunk/context screen shows quality sensitivity to context window size
chunk/context screen shows quality artifacts at chunk boundaries
chunk/context screen implicates the presentation decoder rather than the DiT/world state
chunk/context screen implicates numeric precision (BF16 DiT / FP16 TAEHV)
chunk/context screen shows drift/degradation only under repeated actions or long recurrence
none of the above explain an observed quality gap
nextIf.branch: deeper model/checkpoint limitation review (not yet instantiated)

nodes.notes: First branch is the bounded chunk/context screen only. Do not make every diagnostic above mandatory; instantiate a follow-up node only when the chunk/context screen's own evidence points at it. Blind sweeping across all six branches is explicitly discouraged.

nodes.name: Freeze quality-approved semantic contract
nodes.question: What is the exact operating point we are committing to before policy-dependent performance optimization begins?
entryCriteria: C2 exit criteria satisfied (bounded screen plus any triggered branches resolved or deferred)
exitCriteria: all eight contract fields above recorded and traceable to C2 evidence
nodes.notes: This is a decision/documentation step, not a new GPU experiment; it consumes C2's evidence. The frozen point may or may not equal the RC1 configuration measured in C0B.

nodes.name: Profile the quality-approved runtime
nodes.question: Where does latency actually go in the C3-frozen configuration? (This may differ from the RC1 configuration profiled in C0B if C2/C3 changed any axis.)
exitCriteria: waterfall + attribution profile captured for the frozen configuration
measured hotspot ranking produced
nextIf: ranked hotspot list feeds C5A/C5B naming and count
nodes.notes: Distinct from C0B. Do not assume C0B's hotspot ranking (rolled self-SDPA, non-SDPA clean-KV recomputation) still applies if C3's frozen point differs from RC1's 12+6/3-step/TAEHV configuration.
